reading.title: Apple, Orange, or Grapes?
reading.purpose: Hear two friends compare fruit at lunch.
paras: Rosa says, "Let us contrast an apple and an orange. They are alike in one way. Both are round." Dev says, "They are similar, but unlike an apple, an orange has a thick peel."
Rosa says, "You may have either one." Dev says, "I want neither today. I want grapes. A grape is smaller than an apple, but it is sweet!"

qs.q: Dev says, "Unlike an apple, an orange has a thick peel." What does unlike mean?
qs.why: Unlike means not the same as, so the orange and apple are different here.

qs.q: What is alike about the apple and the orange?
qs.why: Rosa says they are alike because both are round.
Dev wants neither the apple nor the orange. Dev wants grapes.

reading.retellFrame: An apple and an orange are alike because ___.
